name: perplexity_search
text:
# perplexity_search
Ranked web results as data (title, url, snippet, date). No model answer.

Flags: billed.
Cost: $0.001 per fast request, $0.005 per web request, however many queries it merges.

## Example
{"name": "perplexity_search", "arguments": {"query": "python packaging guide", "search_type": "fast", "max_results": 3}}

## Arguments
- query (string or list of string, required) - One query, or a list of 1 to 5 (each at most 8192 characters)
- project (string or null, optional) - Project to record the call under (default: default)
- search_type (string, optional) - fast (default, $0.001 per request) or web ($0.005 per request)
- max_results (integer or null, optional) - Total results across all queries, 1 to 20 (default: the API's 10)
- max_tokens (integer or null, optional) - Cap on page text across all results, 1 to 16384; can drop results
- max_tokens_per_page (integer or null, optional) - Cap on page text per result, 1 to 4096
- domains (list of string or null, optional) - At most 20 domains: all allowed (python.org) or all denied with a '-' prefix (-reddit.com); not mixed
- recency (string or null, optional) - hour, day, week, month or year; not with a date option
- after (string or null, optional) - Published on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD)
- before (string or null, optional) - Published on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD)
- updated_after (string or null, optional) - Last updated on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD)
- updated_before (string or null, optional) - Last updated on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD)
- languages (list of string or null, optional) - At most 20 two-letter lowercase ISO 639-1 codes, e.g. en
- country (string or null, optional) - Two-letter country code to localize the search, e.g. US

## Result keys
- always: results, count, cost_usd, search_type

## Errors
- invalid_request: Up to five queries; filters are checked before any call.
